model.name: R20.11: Drawer close action dismisses the drawer.
model.description: The detail drawer MUST have a CLOSE ACTION that dismisses/hides the drawer entirely (e.g. tap X button, swipe-down dismiss). This is the close() method behavior — the drawer transitions from visible to hidden. Distinct from R19.33 (553be449 = the close AFFORDANCE stays STICKY, which is the CSS visual positioning of the X button, not the close ACTION itself). Method: close() (91efe513, rb-detail-drawer.ts:107).
model.tronQuote: > Derived from existing drawer close UX — the ACTION of dismissing, not the CSS positioning of the button.
model.crossRefNote: R19.33 (sticky close affordance) = CSS positioning of the X button. R20.11 = the CLOSE ACTION itself (drawer hides). Different concerns: visibility vs action.

intendedChain.test: RED: drawer open → trigger close (tap X or swipe) → assert drawer hidden/display:none.
